title: Henry_SLR: code, data, and interactive screening tool for contaminant fate in coastal aquifers under sea level rise
description: Full nonlinear variable-density Henry-problem solver, benchmark scripts, result data, figure-generation code, and a self-contained interactive screening calculator accompanying Farhat & Bolster, 'Contaminant fate in coastal aquifers under sea level rise: analytical solutions for a quasi-static saltwater wedge' (Journal of Contaminant Hydrology).
